Open callOctober 22, 2026

CreArtBox opens its 2027/28 Calls for Scores

Two calls, CA1/2026 for composers of any nationality and CA2/2026 for American composers, take applications from 22 October to 15 December 2026. Any instrumentation, every career stage, and a first round read with no names attached.

ResidencyOctober 16, 2026

Five days in Kuopio

The conservatory asked us how we work rather than what we play. Five days on taking classical music out of its protocol: a concert, a long talk, a workshop with interactive visuals and lights carried around the hall, and two masterclasses.

Read on →
InterviewOctober 2, 2026

Eight questions for Eric Moe

The piece that opens our twelfth season is named after a stream in Montana. Its composer on laminar flow, a tango with three dancers, and what to listen for near the end.

SeasonSeptember 10, 2026

CreArtBox announces its twelfth season

Four productions at The DiMenna Center for Classical Music, eleven works chosen from the ensemble's open call, one world premiere, touring dates in Illinois, Kentucky and the Hudson Valley, a residency in Finland, and the seventh Festival ADAR in Asturias.
